summary: Iteration 17: End-to-end testing of the new Announcement Metrics feature (track + metrics endpoints). Backend pytest: 15/15 PASS covering view/dismiss tracking, per-company deduplication, schema validation, SuperAdmin-only authorization on /metrics, invalid action/id error handling, and that GET /api/announcements now includes views_count and dismissals_count per announcement. Frontend Playwright: Enterprise admin dashboard automatically fires POST /track?action=view for each banner on load (deduplicated server-side, confirmed). Dismiss X button fires POST /track?action=dismiss before hiding banner (2 banners -> 1). SuperAdmin /admin/comunicacion table shows a 'Metricas' column with eye-icon + view count | click-icon + dismiss count per row (observed: 1|0, 1|1, 2|0 matching expected seed state). Clicking a metrics button opens a dialog with title 'Metricas del Anuncio', 3 KPI cards (Opticas vieron / Descartaron / Tasa descarte %), and a per-company detail list showing company_name, user_name and date. Verified Mantenimiento dialog lists Altavista Opticas + Cortexia Optical Demo as the 2 viewing companies, exactly matching backend metrics.

minor.issue: Returns {'message':'ok'} (HTTP 200) silently when the authenticated user has no company_id (e.g., orphan account). Acceptable for a non-critical telemetry endpoint, but a 204 No Content or explicit reason would be more honest.
Performs 2 count_documents per announcement in a loop (N+1). For 200 announcements this is 400 round-trips. Consider a single aggregation pipeline with $lookup or $group on announcement_metrics.

integration_issues.issue: Dashboard fires duplicate POST /track?action=view per banner on load (observed 4 calls for 2 banners). Backend dedup masks the impact, but it doubles network noise and metrics-collection load. Likely caused by React 18 StrictMode double-invoking useEffect or a missing dependency guard.

frontend: Enterprise admin /dashboard fires POST /api/announcements/{id}/track?action=view automatically per visible banner
Enterprise admin clicking X on a banner fires POST /track?action=dismiss and removes banner from view (2 -> 1)
SuperAdmin /admin/comunicacion table renders Metricas column with eye icon + view count, pipe, click icon + dismiss count (data-testid metrics-btn-{id})
Clicking metrics-btn opens dialog with title 'Metricas del Anuncio' and subtitle = announcement title
Dialog shows 3 KPI cards: 'Opticas vieron' (blue), 'Descartaron' (amber), 'Tasa descarte %' (slate)
Tasa descarte computed as round(dismissals/views*100) and renders 0% when views_count is 0 (no division by zero)
Detail rows render with company_name, user_name, date (data-testid view-detail-{i} / dismiss-detail-{i})
Mantenimiento dialog correctly lists Altavista Opticas + Cortexia Optical Demo (matches backend seed state)

action_items: Optional: Guard DashboardPage useEffect against double-firing track?action=view (e.g., useRef sentinel) - currently dedup-saved by backend but doubles request volume
Optional perf: Replace N+1 count_documents loop in GET /api/announcements with a single $group aggregation on announcement_metrics
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/announcements.py L16-20: For every announcement in the list, 2 count_documents queries are issued. With many announcements this is an N+1 pattern. Recommend: collect all _ids, run a single aggregate({$match: {_id: {$in: ids}}}, {$group: {_id: {announcement_id, action}, count: {$sum:1}}}), and zip the results.

/app/backend/routes/announcements.py L67-96: Track endpoint reads action from query string (not body). This is fine but inconsistent with the rest of the REST surface. Also, no rate limiting - a malicious admin could spam track on every announcement; dedup prevents row explosion but still N writes per request batch.

/app/backend/routes/announcements.py L94: created_at is stored as ISO string. metrics endpoint then slices [:10] to extract YYYY-MM-DD. Safer to store as a real datetime (BSON Date) and format on read; current approach breaks if the string format changes.
/app/backend/routes/announcements.py L107-108: Two separate find().to_list(500) calls per metrics request. Could be merged into one $facet aggregation for symmetry and ~half the round-trips.

/app/frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.js L30-33: Track calls fire on every render where announcements change; observed 2x duplicate POSTs per banner on first load. Add a useRef set of already-tracked ids or move into a one-shot useEffect keyed by announcement ids JSON.

/app/frontend/src/pages/AnnouncementsPage.js L143-148: openMetrics catches no error - if the GET fails the dialog will stay in the spinner state forever. Add a try/catch with toast.error and onOpenChange=false on failure.
seed_data_creation: None for permanent data. Each backend test class uses fresh_announcement fixture that creates a TEST_Metrics_Announcement, runs the test, and DELETE-cleans up (also cascades to announcement_metrics rows since DELETE /announcements/{id} clears related metrics).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Metrics feature endpoints: POST /api/announcements/{id}/track?action={view|dismiss} (any authenticated admin, deduped per (announcement, company, action)); GET /api/announcements/{id}/metrics (SuperAdmin only, returns {views_count,dismissals_count,view_details[],dismiss_details[]} where each detail row has company_name,user_name,date). GET /api/announcements list now embeds views_count + dismissals_count per row. Frontend: DashboardPage useEffect auto-tracks views on load; banner X button (data-testid='dismiss-{id}') tracks dismiss and hides banner via setDismissedAnnouncements state. SuperAdmin announcements page has data-testid='metrics-btn-{id}' for each row and 'view-detail-{i}'/'dismiss-detail-{i}' inside the dialog. Existing seeded metric state: Mantenimiento=2 views (Altavista+Demo), Cotizaciones=1 view + 1 dismiss (Altavista), Actualiza tu plan=1 view (Demo). Note: dismiss is intentionally deduped per (announcement, company), so a company calling dismiss twice keeps the count at 1 - by design.
